meta.title: Enterprise Task & Productivity Platform
meta.description: Corporate task management, compliance, and personal productivity in one workspace.

footer.tagline: Unified workspace for tasks and compliance

auth.loginDescription: Enterprise task platform — sign in with your corporate account
auth.errorMissing: Please enter your email and password.
auth.errorSession: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
auth.footerNote: Accounts are provisioned by an administrator only.

integrations.title: Secure integration vault
integrations.subtitle: Secrets are stored with AES-256-GCM and never shown again. Only tools enabled for your account by administrators appear here. Decryption runs on the server only when you run the assistant after approval.
integrations.noToolsStaff: No connection tools are enabled for your account. Please contact your administrator to activate the required integrations.
integrations.noToolsSuper: No connection tools are enabled for this account. You can activate Odoo and email from AI tool governance.
integrations.formMissingOdoo: Could not find the Odoo form.
integrations.formMissingEmail: Could not find the mail form.
integrations.footerNote: Keep CREDENTIALS_ENCRYPTION_KEY secret in your hosting environment (e.g. Netlify) and never commit it to source control.

notices.odoo: Odoo credentials saved securely (password stored encrypted).
notices.odoo_clear: Odoo credentials removed from the vault.
notices.email_clear: Mail settings removed from the vault.

errors.odoo_fields: Complete the Odoo URL and login name.
errors.odoo_password: Odoo password is required on first save.
errors.odoo_encrypt: Encryption failed: verify CREDENTIALS_ENCRYPTION_KEY on the server.
errors.email_fields: Complete mail server fields and usernames.
errors.email_imap_password: IMAP password is required on first save.
errors.email_smtp_password: SMTP password is required on first save.
errors.no_license_odoo: You are not licensed for the Odoo tool — ask a super administrator to assign it in AI tool governance.
errors.no_license_email: You are not licensed for the email tool — ask a super administrator to assign it in AI tool governance.

odoo.title: Odoo
odoo.desc: Server URL, database (optional), login and password — only encrypted values are stored.
odoo.passwordKeep: Leave blank to keep the current secret

email.title: Email IMAP / SMTP
email.desc: Receive and send servers with TLS by default. Leave password fields blank on update to keep existing encrypted secrets.

documentsPage.dialogNewDescription: Enter document details, expiry date, and alert window in days.
documentsPage.dialogEditDescription: Update fields, then save your changes.
